name: CapRover Self-Hosted PaaS
free_limit: Free-forever self-hosted Docker-based app deployment platform with HTTPS and one-click app deployment; no vendor-imposed app or deployment quota in the free self-hosted software.
watch_out: Requires your own server, Docker/Swarm, domain and infrastructure; these costs are not included. The CapRover license appendix requires modifications of free features to remain free/open-source and restricts redistribution of paid versions; paid hosted features are separate.
